section_basis: Reuse the frozen centre and long tangent axis1; use the selected component normal as axis2 so the displayed separation has the same direction as tau; cross axis is axis1 cross axis2
section_width_rule: Use the smallest listed half width with observations from all three sources in all 12 bins; otherwise use the widest and retain gaps. Decide from counts only, never from profile heights or separation.
aggregation: Median of actual projected coordinates in each fixed bin, independently for each source
missing_bins: Keep NaN gaps; do not interpolate or fit a curve
plot_y_limits: All finite bin medians and the full reference plus/minus tau band, plus max(10 percent of their range, 0.04 m) on either side; the plot is a binned profile, not all raw points
photo: Same R6 original photograph and crop; mark the section centre line A-A prime instead of the component hull
display: Use the same reference dots, prior dashed line and MVS solid line as the other cards; show a labelled grey reference plus/minus 20 cm band; explicitly state that normal separation is enlarged
